Our disability income division focuses exclusively on the representation of long term disability insurance claimants in both private policy and group disability (ERISA) claims.

Mark Humphreys Law Firm's office represents individuals being abused and bullied by businesses. They represent small and mid-sized companies in contract disputes and claims against other companies.

feeds.title: Clim Concepts Blog
feeds.description: Claim Concepts is a Boutique Public Adjusting Firm that exclusively represents home and business owners throughout the claim process. We know how to properly investigate, estimate, document, and ultimately recover the maximum claim settlement for even the most complex of residential and commercial insurance claims.

feeds.title: MGW Law Blog
feeds.description: MGW is the only law firm in Wisconsin that specializes in representing those who have been treated unfairly by their insurance companies due to bad faith insurance practices. We specialize in all practice areas of insurance claims, from residential homes to commercial claims. With over fifty years of combined experience working for insurance companies, we know how the process works and we're prepared to make your insurance provider pay what's fair.

feeds.title: Claims Journal

feeds.title: Claims Media
feeds.description: Claims Media is an online community for professionals operating in the UK's claims sector. We work to promote best practice across the industry and provide a platform for lawyers, insurers, claims management companies, alternative business structures, rehab providers, medical agencies and other service providers from which they can share ideas and win new clients.

feeds.title: All Claims USA Blog
feeds.description: All Claims USA Public Adjusters is a leading Public Adjusting Firm. We work exclusively for the policyholder for both residential and commercial insurance claims. Our primary goal is to make sure you get the maximum settlement you are entitled to under your insurance policy. We provide peace of mind and help you get your home or business back to normal as soon as possible.

feeds.title: The Professional Law Group Blog
feeds.description: We are attorneys. We have a strong understanding of how insurance companies operate. We help clients with new, delayed, underpaid, and denied insurance claims. Our mission is to help people whose lives or businesses have been disrupted by property damage from an insured event.

feeds.title: Hunton Insurance Recovery Blog
feeds.description: The insurance litigation and counseling lawyers at Hunton & Williams LLP blog addresses all aspects of insurance coverage, helping our clients maximize insurance recoveries through insurance program reviews, claims presentation and negotiation, litigation, alternate dispute resolution, trials and appeals.

feeds.title: Law Office of David Gongora Blog
feeds.description: David Gongora is a Florida Property Insurance Claim Attorney and concentrates his practice in representing property owners when their property insurance company refuses to pay a claim or when their property insurance claim is underpaid or undervalued. Our experience and network of claim professionals are specifically tailored for one purpose - to get you everything you are entitled to under your policy.

feeds.title: Florida's Best Public Adjusters Blog
feeds.description: We share the same goals as you do, getting the maximum financial compensation for damages caused to your home or business! Our Public Adjusters in Florida will ensure a speedy recovery process and get the most out of your insurance claim. We have a team of highly experienced professionals who are here to help you adjust your claim.

feeds.title: CORE Public Adjusters Blog
feeds.description: CORE Public Adjusters provides comprehensive damage estimates. We have staff members in place, all experts in their job roles, from estimating your damage and monitoring the claims process to getting you paid fast, and everything in between.
